xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF ingested from GitHub issue #6099

plan.title: perf(cache): reuse open-issue list payload in drift probe instead of refetching up to 25 issues

narratives.Description: perf(cache): reuse open-issue list payload in drift probe instead of refetching up to 25 issues
narratives.Overview:
- relieves: P1 — Inside probeCacheDrift’s default path, list once into a call-scoped Map and derive live-open membership from its keys without changing listOpenIssueNumbers or the listOpenFn Set type.
- relieves: P1 — When listOpenFn is injected, build no records Map and perform no second enumeration so injected-Set callers stay byte-identical to today.
- relieves: P1 — Reuse each eligible Map record through normaliseRestIssue then issueContentFingerprint before any singleIssueFetcherImpl call, taking only the call-scoped Map-first shape from runFetchAll, not its unguarded completeness policy.
- relieves: P2 — Leave the evaluate.ts cache_fresh call site seam-free so the only caller that pays the sampled GETs gains reuse with no call-site edit.
- relieves: P3 — Gate reuse with present keys via the in operator plus usable values: body must be string or null, title and state must be strings, and labels must be an array whose entries expose usable string names.
- relieves: P3 — On any missing required key or unusable body/title/state/labels shape, call fetchSingle exactly once for that number and never skip the content check.
- relieves: P3 — Prove seamless-default reuse in one run with schema-valid TTL-fresh meta fixtures, exactly one mutated list record, contentDriftNumbers equal to that number, and zero fetchSingle calls under setPaginatedLister and setSingleIssueFetcher with only repo/source/cacheRoot.
- relieves: P3 — Add present-but-undefined body and invalid title/state fixtures that assert exactly one fetchSingle fallback and drift detection from the fallback fingerprint.
- Keep comparison-count DEFAULT_MAX_CONTENT_DRIFT_CHECKS behavior unchanged in this Prefer-A; do not re-point the counter to fetchSingle-only in this ticket.
- Keep-outs: deleting or optionalizing .deft-cache/github-issue; changing verify:cache-fresh meaning when upstream data matches; applying the new eligibility predicate to pre-existing runFetchAll Map-first reuse; ghx/#3513; sleepImpl Retry-After fix; Approach B return-type churn; Approach C module memo.
narratives.UserStory: As a session-start operator, cache drift probing should reuse the open-issue list payload instead of refetching up to 25 issues.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Stamp Prefer-A Recut-1 Bound 6691254585: list-once Map reuse with usable-value eligibility; injected-Set path unchanged; seamless-default proof.
